versions.changelog:
verified-agent-identity 1.0.0

- Initial release of a decentralized identity skill for AI agents using the Billions Network.
- Enables agents to create, manage, and link decentralized identities (DIDs) to human owners.
- Provides scripts for identity generation, challenge creation, challenge signing, human/agent linking, signature verification, and listing stored identities.
- All sensitive data managed securely within $HOME/.openclaw/billions; strict security and operational guardrails enforced.
- Based on the iden3 self-sovereign identity protocol and Billions ERC-8004/Attestation Registries.
